gaps_reproduced_on_base.observed: Selecting the 2nd occurrence ('South pier: the tide returns the ledger', y 186-202) painted the 1st (North pier, y 136-155); stored position/prefix pointed at the first occurrence. The committed journey on base fails at its first PDF step: 'painted on [North pier...], expected [South pier...]'.

EPUB: a real drag selected 'quiet weather' in the book iframe but no highlight pill appeared (0 selectionchange events). Root cause: epub.js renders books in sandbox=allow-same-origin without scripts; WebKit runs no event listeners for that document (even a synthetic event dispatched by the app did not run its listener), so epub.js 'selected' never fires and its click proxy for painted highlights never runs.

remove/note failures were swallowed (UI showed the highlight removed while the sidecar kept it, so it returned on restart); an add failure replaced the whole reader with an error.

PDF text layer ignored zoom: the 'South pier...' line was 0.707 of the page width in fit-page and 0.451 in fit-width, while pdf.js measures the item at 0.538 (329.17/612pt). Cause: pdf.js 6 sizes text-layer glyphs with --total-scale-factor, defined only by its own viewer; the reader set only --scale-factor. Selection and highlight geometry drifted from the rendered glyphs.

known_risks: PDF intra-line glyph geometry comes from pdf.js's text layer (fallback font scaled to each item's true width): a highlight's ends can be about one glyph off the rendered letters (visible in 02-pdf-fit-width.png); line-level anchoring is exact and the line width matches pdf.js ground truth.

EPUB selection is read by polling the book frame's selection every 250ms (WebKit runs no listeners in the sandboxed, script-free book frame); not yet exercised on WebView2, where epub.js's own event also fires (same data, deduplicated by selection).
Painted EPUB highlights now take pointer clicks, so text under a highlight cannot be drag-selected starting on the highlight itself.
